stories.title: US aviation shutdown blamed on a single L3Harris-installed router
stories.summary: A nearly five-hour US aviation shutdown that disrupted more than 20,000 flights may trace to a single router installed by contractor L3Harris, officials said. The failure renewed scrutiny of the aging air-traffic-control telecom system.

stories.title: Iran's navy says three oil tankers caught fire after hitting mines in Strait of Hormuz
stories.summary: Iran's navy said three oil tankers caught fire after striking naval mines in the Strait of Hormuz and warned ships to avoid a restricted zone. The incidents escalate tensions between Iran, the US and Israel in a vital oil chokepoint.

stories.title: Eli Lilly CEO pushes back on Anthropic chief's 'cure everything' medical claims
stories.summary: Eli Lilly's CEO joined critics pushing back on Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei's prediction that AI will cure cancer and heart disease within a decade. The pushback comes as Anthropic moves toward its Nasdaq IPO.

stories.title: Browns host Texans in must-win Week 10 matchup before bye
stories.summary: The Browns (5-4) host the Texans in Week 10 needing to snap a two-game losing streak before their bye, with Deshaun Watson returning at quarterback against his former team. A third straight loss would drop Cleveland to 5-5 and out of playoff position.

stories.title: Deshaun Watson starts as Browns host Texans with bye week looming
stories.summary: Deshaun Watson starts Sunday's 1 p.m. game against Houston in what cleveland.com calls a 'prove-it game' against his former team. Cleveland has slipped from first to third in the AFC North after two straight losses.

stories.title: Hey, Mary Kay: Must Watson keep earning the Browns' starting job weekly?
stories.summary: Mary Kay Cabot fields readers' questions on whether Deshaun Watson must keep earning the Browns' starting quarterback job each week. The mailbag comes as Watson faces a pivotal game against his former team.

stories.title: Ohio State men's basketball opens season Monday with expanded NCAA field
stories.summary: With the NCAA Tournament field expanded, Ohio State men's basketball has fewer excuses as it opens its season Monday night against UIC. The Buckeyes are aiming to end a run of disappointing seasons.

stories.title: Ryan Day praises resilience as Buckeyes snap skid over Northwestern
stories.summary: Ohio State snapped a two-game losing streak with a 28-19 win over Northwestern, and Ryan Day praised his team for bouncing back. Jeremiah Smith set the Big Ten career receiving record in the victory.

stories.title: Three Ohio counties to watch as voters decide Senate, governor races
stories.summary: Ohio's closely contested Senate and governor races will test whether Democrats can regain ground in former strongholds. Wood County has backed every US Senate winner in Ohio since 1982.

stories.title: NBC4's Season of Giving with Besa returns to brighten seniors' holidays
stories.summary: NBC4's Season of Giving with Besa launched WISH, letting central Ohioans fill a holiday wish list for a senior in need. The program has grown from 26 seniors in 2012 to more than 2,000 across 13 counties.

stories.title: Early voting wraps up with strong turnout ahead of Ohio Election Day
stories.summary: Ohio wrapped up early voting with strong turnout ahead of Election Day. The Senate and governor races drew heavy statewide interest.

stories.title: Supreme Court to review home-distilling ban fought by Newark, Ohio brewer
stories.summary: The US Supreme Court will review a federal home-distilling ban challenged by a Newark, Ohio brewer. Conflicting lower-court rulings mean the ban currently applies differently in Texas and Ohio.
